# nemau_keypair (Resource)

An SSH keypair usable as an instance's `key_name`.

Without `public_key`, the platform generates an Ed25519 pair and returns the private key once. Terraform stores it in state, and it cannot be retrieved anywhere else. If your state is not encrypted, supply your own `public_key` instead.

Do not use a slash in the name: such a keypair can be created but not deleted.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nemau_keypair" "deploy" {
  name       = "deploy"
  public_key = file(pathexpand("~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub"))
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Keypair name. It also serves as the id. Changing it replaces the keypair.

### Optional

- `public_key` (String) OpenSSH public key to register. When omitted, a pair is generated.

### Read-Only

- `fingerprint` (String) Fingerprint of the public key, as the platform reports it.
- `id` (String) Same as `name`.
- `private_key` (String, Sensitive) The generated private key, empty when `public_key` was supplied. Not retrievable afterwards.
